description: Behavior patterns (.agents/patterns/README.md). Checked by tools/pattern_guard.py. canonical: the component files and symbols that own a behavior; owns: further files the pattern owns (globs); guards: regexes that must not match outside 'allow' (or listed 'debt') globs, ignoring comment lines; internal: scoped files that belong to no pattern, each with a reason. Apple paths only. web: the React dashboard sources the behavior ports (informational, not checked).

internal.reason: Generic Optional-to-Bool binding helper; not a UI behavior.
The app icon art, shared by the icon renderer and the Live Activity corner mark; art, not a screen behavior.
The icon's house-and-heart Shape; art shared with AppIconArtwork.
Redaction switch for sensitive screens in screenshots and recordings; a platform guard, not a shared look.

patterns.title: Action tiles
patterns.summary: the one way a tile shows and runs actions: trailing or below discs, the chevron beside them, feedback kinds, availability motion.

patterns.title: Alerts and confirmations
patterns.summary: how the app asks "are you sure?" and reports a failure: one presenter, one set of words, one role per decision.

guards.message: Alert and dialog titles come from AlertCopy, never a literal in a view (alerts).

patterns.title: Avatar
patterns.summary: how a person is drawn as a disc (photo or initials), and how their Home Assistant photo is synced, cached and removed.

patterns.title: Bedroom devices (wake light, bed sides)
patterns.summary: the Primary Bedroom's Wake-Light Alarms and bed sides: tiles, sheets, alarm editors, the active alarm and the Tonight/All Nights prompt.

patterns.title: Camera streams
patterns.summary: how live camera video is shared, started, stopped and brought back.

patterns.title: Content gate
patterns.summary: how a page waits for its content before showing it.

patterns.title: Design tokens
patterns.summary: the one set of spacing, radius, colour, ink, surface and type values every screen draws from.

patterns.title: Dynamic grid
patterns.summary: the responsive tile grid.

patterns.title: Entity tile
patterns.summary: the glass tile used for entity controls.

guards.message: Light power is an explicit turn_on / turn_off from the shown state, never toggle (entity-tile).

patterns.title: Floating actions and filter sheets
patterns.summary: page-level floating buttons (Add Task, Add Groceries, Scan Item, recipe/inventory Search, Sort, Filter) and the sort/filter sheets they open.

patterns.title: Header edge fade
patterns.summary: how scrolling content meets a page or modal header.

guards.message: Only the header fade hides the navigation bar background or the top scroll-edge effect (header-edge-fade R1).

patterns.title: Hinge avoidance
patterns.summary: how content stays off the iPhone Duo's hinge band and keeps a readable width on iPad.

patterns.title: Image cache
patterns.summary: how remote images load, cache and update.

guards.message: Remote images load through ImagePipeline / CachedImage, never AsyncImage (image-cache).
Views do not decode images with UIImage(data:); decode through ImagePipeline (image-cache).

patterns.title: Image card
patterns.summary: a tappable card with a remote image, title and subtitle.

patterns.title: Info box
patterns.summary: a tinted notice with a title and optional message.

patterns.title: Media remote
patterns.summary: the media remote sheet (the 3×3 remote grid with power, and the Remote/Apps/Devices/Hue Sync sections) shared by every TV in the house.

patterns.title: Modal sheet
patterns.summary: how web hash modals become native sheets.

guards.message: Sheet detents come from hassSheet() / SheetFit, never a bare presentationDetents (modal-sheet).

patterns.title: Module list
patterns.summary: inset lists on the wallpaper (direction G, Controls: Lists).

patterns.title: Motion
patterns.summary: the shared components that apply the app-wide motion rules.

patterns.title: List row removal
patterns.summary: the one way a diffable list applies a snapshot: the system animation for a row or section that leaves, never on a reapply.

guards.message: A diffable list applies its snapshot through UKListUpdater, never dataSource.apply(_:animatingDifferences:) (list-row-removal).

patterns.title: Optimistic actions
patterns.summary: how a control shows its new value at once and stays honest.

patterns.title: Option picker
patterns.summary: picking one value from a short list in a sheet.

patterns.title: Page backdrop
patterns.summary: the blurred photo of the house behind every page.

patterns.title: Page indicator
patterns.summary: the one page indicator for every paging row and carousel (Food suggestions, the Weather sheet, the hourly rows).

patterns.title: Resume lifecycle
patterns.summary: the rule that a background and foreground leaves the app exactly as the first launch did, and the census that proves it.

patterns.title: Room device sheets
patterns.summary: the device sheets opened from room tiles: bathroom fan, air quality (purifier), humidifier, grill.

patterns.title: Room overview sheet
patterns.summary: the room-by-room sheets behind Home's Lights, Climate, Occupancy, Contact Sensors and Air Quality chips, and the room detail they push.

patterns.title: Schedule date fields
patterns.summary: date-and-time pickers for schedules.

patterns.title: Scroll fit
patterns.summary: a vertical scroll view scrolls and bounces only when its content is taller than its viewport.

guards.message: Use scrollsOnlyWhenNeeded() / pullToRefresh from HassDesign, not a per-view scrollBounceBehavior (scroll-fit).

patterns.title: Settings section
patterns.summary: a settings page's header + description + controls block, and the pieces that go in it.

patterns.title: State message
patterns.summary: the empty and error state ("No Chores Due", "Unable to Load Recipes").

patterns.title: Status pill
patterns.summary: a read-only labeled value with a toned icon.

patterns.title: Status rail
patterns.summary: the horizontal chip row under a page title.

patterns.title: Tap feedback
patterns.summary: the one haptic vocabulary and the failure feedback built on it.

guards.message: Haptics go through TapFeedback / tapFeedback(_:trigger:), never a UIKit feedback generator (tap-feedback).
Name the haptic with a TapFeedback constant (TapFeedback.step), not a literal feedback (tap-feedback).

patterns.title: Telemetry
patterns.summary: how the app measures its own performance.

patterns.title: Thermostat dial
patterns.summary: the circular setpoint dial for `climate` entities.

patterns.title: Ticker label
patterns.summary: one line of text that scrolls through its column when it is too wide, instead of truncating.

patterns.title: Vacuum sheet
patterns.summary: the robot vacuum sheet (map, status, Controls/Rooms/Auto-Clean/Dock/Info tabs, area editor, cleaning report).

patterns.title: Mapped map
patterns.summary: decoding and drawing a Mapped map (rooms, walls, robot, dock, paths, areas).

patterns.title: Weather card and sheet
patterns.summary: the Home weather card, its 24-hour carousel and the Weather sheet, plus the logic under them.

guards.message: A static let (one line or many) that reads a flipped house-config facade freezes the first value until relaunch; use a computed static var (architecture.md, House config facades).
Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues:) traps on a repeated key, and a file that reads a house-config facade builds it from server data; use uniquingKeysWith: { first, _ in first }.

patterns.title: Scroll frame rate
patterns.summary: no app refresh-rate request while scrolling (iOS manages it); scroll surfaces report to ScrollActivity.

patterns.title: Swipe row
patterns.summary: swipe actions on rows of a plain stack (iOS 18+), the List's on iOS 17.

patterns.title: Check row
patterns.summary: the one checkable row: a check circle, the text, an optional trailing accessory.

patterns.title: Modal inventory
patterns.summary: every modal in the app, how it is presented, what it holds, how it behaves in each pose, and the bugs found.

patterns.title: Page base
patterns.summary: the one way a page, a pane or a tab hosts its scrolling body, spaces it, pins a bar under it and gets its ground.

patterns.title: Rows
patterns.summary: the one list row: slots for a leading glyph, check or avatar, the text and a trailing accessory or chevron.
